neighbours.label: The subject or modal right after 'how far' ('how far she has come', 'how far you can stretch', 'how far we could go'), where 'come/reach/go' is expected next; 'how much / how long / how often' stay lower.
fire: Looking back, I can't believe how far we have come.
The test shows how far the car can travel on one charge.
Nobody knows how far the storm will move inland.
It's inspiring to see how far he has progressed this year.
They wondered how far the river could rise.
Coaches measure how far each player can throw.
She asked how far they would walk before dark.
You never know how far a small kindness can go.
quiet: Looking back, I can't believe how much we have spent.
The test shows how long the car can run on one charge.
Nobody knows when the storm will move inland.
It's inspiring to see how hard he has worked this year.
They wondered why the river was rising.
Coaches measure how often each player can score.
She asked whether they would walk before dark.
You never know how much a small kindness can mean.
